title: The Synthetic Grain Heist
logline: A disgraced logistics factor who once designed an automated grain silo to protect a station from starvation plans to raid it when the local syndicate corners the supply to drive up prices.

roles.description: Former municipal silo designer; weathered, guilt-ridden, knowing every maintenance flaw in the fortress vault he built.
Commercial grain monopolist; sharp, suave, hoarding sixty thousand tons of synthetic wheat behind armored blast doors.
A weaponized patrol cutter guarding the grain silo intake docks.
Station dock laborers whose bread ration has been halved by artificial price spikes.
The private agricultural holding firm controlling bulk carbohydrate distribution.
A heavily fortified orbital grain silo anchored to a hollowed metallic asteroid.
A crowded black-market bazaar in the unpressurized lower station spine.

public_situation: Ration riots flare along station docks as {role:grain_consortium} doubles the price of synthetic flour while keeping {role:grain_citadel} sealed under armed guard.
private_truth: The architect built an emergency drainage valve into the silo's fire-suppression vents fifteen years ago, intending it as a municipal safety release that management never discovered.

beats.public_change: Security barriers lock down the approach corridors to {role:grain_citadel} as bulk grain futures spike sixty percent on station boards.

missions.reason: Scan the orbital silo's automated vent exhaust to locate the structural service hatch he built into the blueprints fifteen years ago.
missions.private_fact: He took a fifty-thousand-credit bonus for designing the silo to be impregnable against civilian mobs.

beats.public_change: Syndicate patrol vessels deploy active minelets along the intake pylons after detecting anomalous sensor probes on the silo hull.

missions.reason: Disable the automated defense skiff patrolling the exterior intake rail and recover its encrypted biometric docking transponder.
missions.private_fact: The syndicate factor is his former son-in-law, who used his family connection to gain control of the silo charter.

beats.public_change: The architect taps the silo drainage controls, preparing to dump thousands of tons of pressurized flour into siphoning freight shuttles.

missions.reason: Destroy the syndicate escort frigates guarding the grain transfer conduit so the siphon pipes can be coupled.
missions.private_fact: The architect poisoned his own career by admitting to the union that the silo's fire-suppression system can be reversed to dump grain.

missions.reason: Deliver thirty tons of siphoned grain concentrates directly to the union relief distribution bakery.
missions.private_fact: He knows this raid will make him a wanted felon across the system for the rest of his life.

player_choice.prompt: The grain siphon is active and the silo holds sixty thousand tons. The pilot has broken the defense perimeter.

options.label: Blow the silo valves wide open to flood the underdock market with free bread, bankrupting the syndicate
Use the siphon leverage to force the syndicate factor to sign a binding five-year price freeze for the union
Sell the blueprints and architectural backdoors back to the syndicate factor for a private fortune

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot blows the drainage valves and floods the docks with grain.
resolutions.summary: The silo is emptied into station cargo barges. Bread prices collapse overnight, the syndicate faces insolvency, and {role:disgraced_architect} is vindicated.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot cracked open an impregnable corporate grain fortress to feed three starving decks of dockworkers.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot brokers a compromise under threat of emptying the silo.
resolutions.summary: A binding price-ceiling accord is established. {role:dockworkers_union} secures affordable rations, while {role:grain_consortium} keeps ownership of the silo.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot betrays the architect and sells the backdoor codes to management.
resolutions.summary: The architect's backdoors are sealed with fresh armor. {role:syndicate_factor} doubles bread prices, while {role:disgraced_architect} disappears into exile.

resolutions.reached_by: The siphon assault fails or the pilot never intervenes.
resolutions.summary: The raid is repelled by automated defenses. The syndicate locks down distribution, starving the docks into submission and crushing labor resistance.

loose_threads.detail: Architectural blueprints for {role:grain_citadel} carry an encrypted dedication line to a child who died of malnutrition.
Commercial shipping manifests show thirty grain barges diverted to deep cold-storage orbits the week bread subsidies ended.
A crate of high-pressure hydraulic override valves found in the underdock carries inspection tags signed by a dead inspector.

radio_hooks: Station bread prices double overnight as commercial grain consortium restricts flour releases.
Labor pickets clash with private security around orbital agricultural storage fortresses.
Commodity brokers report unusual trading spikes in synthetic flour forward delivery vouchers.

voice_direction.disgraced_architect: Low, raspy, and self-loathing. Talks in precise structural tolerances but his knuckles crack with rage whenever corporate margins are mentioned.
voice_direction.syndicate_factor: Smooth, condescending, and icy. Speaks of starvation as an efficient inventory clearing event and dismisses ethical appeals with cold amusement.
